postal_system.placeholder_rule: 000, 0000, 000000 and HKG are form workarounds, not assigned postcodes. 852, 999077, GeoAddress and AGID must not be substituted as local official postcodes.

identifier_namespaces.scope: source-declared Hong Kong building or address location
identifier_namespaces.rule: A location identifier may have several textual addresses; it is not a unique textual-address row, unit, postal code or polygon.

identifier_namespaces.authority: Digital Policy Office aggregated address service
identifier_namespaces.scope: explicit response snapshot and record pointer
identifier_namespaces.rule: Retain source fields and bilingual variants independently; a digest plus response pointer is snapshot identity, not a permanent government ID.
Derived grid identity does not override source country HK or prove a postal area, entrance, parcel or building footprint.

stages.definition: Identify Hongkong Post no-postcode policy and separate ADI/ALS location and address sources.
Review the no-postcode, bilingual-address, geometry, rights and privacy contract with bounded source checks and negative tests.

A rights-cleared current real HK address dataset with explicit scope and snapshot identity reproducibly produces published digest-pinned address-context artifacts and passes namespace-aware AGID loader/API checks; retain no-postcode semantics and source-linked civic/building fields without inventing postal areas, validity dates or national coverage.
Independent holdout, completeness, ambiguity, currency and source-linked building/entrance checks pass within the declared scope.
Reviewed source refresh, corrections, version history and rollback operate repeatedly under approved rights and privacy conditions.

agid_integration.current_scope: HK source registry plus an experimental in-memory ALS candidate adapter and coordinate-cell checks; no generic country-only Postal Context API enabled.
agid_integration.enablement_gate: Publish a rights-reviewed no-postcode address-context descriptor and verify the real loader/API before runtime enablement. Existing postcode-normalization routes must not receive GeoAddress as a postcode.
agid_integration.coordinate_rule: Use explicit WGS84 Latitude/Longitude, never decode GeoAddress HK1980 digits as geographic degrees. Keep source HK identity even if a coarse AGID prefix differs.
